summary: Implemented GA-grade coordination and safety features, including a participant-only Game Chat with abuse controls (block/report) and moderation audit trails. Chat uses a robust polling mechanism for near-realtime updates on both Web and Mobile.

environment_readiness.infra_evidence: PostgreSQL and Redis containers are healthy.

major_decisions.reason: Simplest reliable implementation across platforms without requiring WebSocket state management or extra infrastructure for the initial GA release.
major_decisions.tradeoffs: Latency of up to 5s and increased server load compared to WebSockets.

major_decisions.decision: Server-side hiding of messages from blocked users and soft-deletion of messages.
major_decisions.reason: Prioritizes user safety while maintaining audit trails for future moderation.
major_decisions.tradeoffs: Messages remain in DB but are excluded from API responses.

major_decisions.reason: Ensures privacy and prevents harassment from outside the immediate game context.
major_decisions.tradeoffs: Users must wait for approval before coordinating.

tests.name: Chat & Safety API tests
tests.notes: Verified list, send, block effects, and report creation.

tests.name: All quality gates
tests.notes: 31 API tests and all frontend smoke tests pass.

acceptance_checklist.evidence: Implemented in chat route with canChat helper.
Server-side filtering based on Block model implemented.
5s polling implemented in both GameChat components.

errors.error: Foreign key constraint violation during cleanup.

errors.how_fixed_or_next_steps: Used specific types to remove any.

next_recommendations: Upgrade to WebSockets/SSE for true realtime chat.
Implement push notifications for new chat messages.
Build basic Admin Moderation UI to review reports.

rules_summary.who_can_chat: Approved participants and the game host only.
rules_summary.blocked_behavior: Blocker cannot see blocked user's messages; messages are filtered server-side.
